ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: According to the “schematic diagram of human understanding of the human-land relationship in different historical periods” shown in <image1>, what was humans’ main attitude toward the natural environment in the period of Figure 1?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In Figure ①, “human society” is located at the center, and “environment” is around the outside. The arrows show that human society obtains “material energy” from the environment while discharging “waste” into the environment; there are also arrows in the vertical direction labeled “development,” indicating that humans actively develop and transform the natural environment. Then reason: This diagram highlights humans as centered on themselves, emphasizes the development and transformation of the natural environment by humans, and reflects an attitude in which humans try to dominate nature and conquer nature. Therefore, in the period of Figure 1, humans’ main attitude toward the natural environment was “conquest.”
